oracle.physical_context: Exact canonical parent geometry; pinned model/head/package/checkpoint, FP32 and TF32 off
oracle.counting_scope: Logical single-point attempts, each requesting E/F/stress; not instrumented neural-backbone forward counts; cache reuses are NOT fresh calls

training.fitted_model_usefulness: Not inferred from successful training or this execution audit

rows.scope: Existing training geometries; engineering and time profile, not a new assessment

engineering_inference.scope: Separate recorded engineering EFS calls; not new benchmark candidates or neural-backbone forward counts

allocations.timestamp_check: Bookkeeping tolerances:2s for integer-second Start/End versus ElapsedRaw;120s for a running row versus export snapshot. Findings require review, not a changed scientific tolerance.
allocations.scope: Allocated wall time includes startup, idle, failed work and CPU analysis; no child-step double counting; no monetary/credit estimate

physical_scope: Execution, exact identity/context, accounting and software receipts only; not DFT accuracy, statistical adequacy, global minima or transport validation
exclusions: Relaxation/MD/NEB force-call counters must be supplied by their own recorded pilots. This audit does not invent uninstrumented forward calls or count cache reuses as new EFS.
